mechanism: Cenobamate inhibits CYP2C9 and may increase valproic acid levels; valproic acid may displace cenobamate from protein binding and increase its free fraction, while both drugs share CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor valproic acid and cenobamate levels closely; assess for increased valproic acid toxicity (tremor, ataxia, hyperammonemia) and cenobamate efficacy; consider dose adjustments based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
